_about: FINAL FILL ORDER item 4 (reviewer, 30 Sep 2026): a small component with no measured weight gets a Versandgewicht from its SHIPPING CLASS (derived:shipping-class, this table the witness); its Artikelgewicht stays empty until a measured weight exists; shop_ready accepts the Versandgewicht for these kinds only. Fans included by the reviewer's verdict of 30 Sep ~12:40 UTC. A tier is a PARCEL class, never a claim about the part's weight. Rows are the (category, kind) pairs the prediction counted (921 parts whose only blocker is weight). A tier rounds UP: for shipping the maximum is the safe side (ruling Q25).
measured: served weights of live Cisco hardware of the same (category, kind), 30 Sep 2026 ~13:30 UTC: transceiver/cable n=18 median 0.27 p90 0.55 max 0.60 kg; transceiver/breakout-cable n=10 median 0.60 p90 0.80 max 0.80; switches/fan n=8 median 2.6 p90 4.4 max 5.2; routers/fan n=8 median 5.67 p90 12.2 max 12.59. No other small-component kind holds a measured weight.
